sources.name: Wikidata structured metadata
sources.capabilities: Structured names, golf classification, birth dates, country labels, venue identity, major editions, source-reported dates and winner assertions. References retained and assertion status disclosed; no independently verified scoring feed.
sources.history_depth: Controlled selected major editions 2024–2026; incomplete careers and championship history
sources.live_capability: None
sources.access_evidence: HTTP 200 documented wbsearchentities and wbgetentities, bounded captures archived to golf-source R2 before parsing; no linked official website probes
sources.robots: Documented API access policy applies; no article HTML scraping
sources.licence: Structured main-namespace data CC0. Does not grant rights to external references or linked photographs.
sources.redistribution: Structured main-namespace data CC0. Does not grant rights to external references or linked photographs.
sources.commercial_use: Structured main-namespace data CC0. Does not grant rights to external references or linked photographs.
sources.attribution: Voluntary provenance credit; asset licence governs
sources.refresh_cadence: Manual bounded bootstrap; no cron. Source lease and sixty-second manual-run separation. Three source requests spaced at least 1.1 seconds, maximum forty entities per request; daily minimum if later automated.
sources.identity_strategy: Scoped canonical UUID plus unique Wikidata crosswalk; human + golf sport + day-precision DOB required. Multiple conflicting statements hold. No merge by names.
sources.provenance: R2 immutable bytes and dependency packets; SPORTS golf_source_captures retain source URL, captured timestamp, SHA-256, archive key, rights version and parser wikidata-golf/1.1.0. No source effective timestamp is invented.
sources.owner_approval: 2026-10-01 production sprint authorizes reviewed zero-cost source ingestion; CC0 structured facts only.
sources.correction_behavior: Append-only captures; typed transactional comparison, golf_source_changes before/after ledger; removed winner assertions retract from the public winner projection. Venue claims absent in the latest edition project unavailable.
